implementation: Implemented bounded producer source, tests, declarations and documentation; source/seam verification complete with explicit strict-compile and link-case gaps.

dependencyMaterialization.preflightOutput: VERIFIED seed regular inventory 3928 files / 138700581 bytes; copy beginning

design.sourceAcquisition: Optional NativePorts.readSourceRGBA receives asset request plus exact native texture/source/index/maxBytes. Full RGBA8 input validates source identity, dimensions, integer frame bounds and exact bytes before copying. No consumer uniformity assertions.
design.compression: Per-region exact equality of every RGBA channel across an actually repeated axis, only with the original full source period and zero phase. Proven identical columns/rows become stock Image 1-pixel strips/fills. Unproven axes retain exact original period, source offsets and cropped tails; unavailable readback retains legacy tiling and all existing budgets.

budgets.scope: per mount; no output-sized raster cache

design.cache: Private copied bytes keyed by immutable native source, guarded by texture/index identity; compiled fragment keys additionally include source identity. Disposal clears planes and compiled command references. Caller must replace source identity for changed borrowed art.
design.transient: Immutable role.placement.nativeStates reserves hover/focus/pressed/disabled variants with skin/tone/glyphTint/paintOffset/visible only. Disabled > pressed > hover > focus > base; selected override merges only with base. Precompiled state commands update native appearance without interaction.update or a second input owner. Offsets must be physically integral.
design.stateOwner: metadata[ui:stateOwner] links only noninteractive text/icon siblings to a button in the same mounted tree. Layout checks sibling relationship, link/authority/focus-role validity; interaction independently rejects forged invalid links. Existing metadata semantic identity enforces rebind revisions and held cancellation. Omission adds no public snapshot fields or renamed IDs.
design.validation: All authored states validate source assets/tones/skin minimum allocations, object/fragment/byte budgets before native mutation. Combined per-record worst-case object count is bounded. Selected mixed-state fragment sets validate before reconciliation.
design.lifecycle: Only owned objects and unregistered native Frame clones are released. Retired fragments/objects are removed before replacements to keep admitted budgets exact. Native mutation/allocation failures retire the mount and drain all owned resources, retaining cleanup failures. Borrowed texture registration/destruction is never used.
design.publicApiCorrection: Installed Phaser declarations expose Frame support on Image.setFrame, not on factory frame arguments or Image.setTexture. Native renderer now creates an Image with the borrowed Texture then uses setFrame(clone); structural declarations match those public signatures, with no any casts.
design.closure: Unchanged eight ESM/eight declaration closure and single software publisher; no new module, art, package/lock/version or aliases changed.
